description: Amortization Schedule Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. What is my monthly payment? Each payment pays the interest first. The rest pays down what you owe. It finds the fixed monthly payment for the loan. Each month, interest is paid first and the rest pays down the loan. It does not count taxes, insurance or fees in the payment. People ask for it as "amortization schedule calculator", "mortgage amortization calculator" or "loan amortization calculator".

amount.description: Amount you borrow. US dollars. Default: 300000.

extra.description: Extra each month. US dollars. For more ways to pay early, use the mortgage payoff calculator. Default: 0.

rate.description: Interest rate. A percent: 5 means 5%. Default: 6.5.

years.description: Years to pay it back. In years. Home loans are often 15 or 30 years. Car loans are often 5. Default: 30.
